metadata.analysis_basis: Only the supplied RFP, Python discipline files, and MATLAB reference ZIP
metadata.important_note: The uploaded JSON said design_range_nmi=500, while its cruise segment and source note said 1200 nmi. This integrated file uses 1200 nmi and retains the RFP minimum separately.

geometry.source: AR from supplied requirements JSON; span limit from RFP; wing area not supplied

aerodynamics.source: CD0=0.028 from supplied TtpaAero.m; high-lift/configuration data were not supplied

payload.source: RFP: at least 9 passengers, 50 lb baggage each, and two pilots; all people assumed 180 lb

propulsion.source: Twin-prop name plus BSFC=0.4, cruise eta=0.82, and loiter eta=0.72 from supplied MATLAB files. Neutral fuel-only settings preserve those equations until hybrid component data are supplied.
propulsion.hybrid_completion_note: To assess the RFP zero-emission takeoff/landing requirement, replace the neutral phi values and fill the null electric, battery, installed-power, and climb-efficiency inputs.

std_mission.description: Team design mission from the supplied requirements and MATLAB mission files.

report_mission_analysis_requirements: Describe design missions based on listed existing operators and show requirements flow-down.
Select cruise altitude, cruise speed, and climb rates using trade analyses and discussion.
Select payload weight using existing-operator and market analysis.
Present an aircraft concept of operations.
Design docking, passenger boarding, and baggage-loading procedures for existing infrastructure, and explain configuration impacts.
